description: Verify that TCP supports simultaneous OPEN attempts (RFC 1122 §4.2.2.10 p87, RFC 793 §3.4 simultaneous-open path)
approach:
[Objective]
When both peers issue active OPEN at nearly the same time, the SYN-SENT → SYN-RCVD → ESTABLISHED simultaneous-open transition replaces the usual three-way handshake.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in SYN-SENT (after active OPEN).
2. Tester → DUT: SYN (not SYN,ACK).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: SYN,ACK and DUT in ESTABLISHED   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT replies SYN,ACK to the simultaneous SYN AND reaches ESTABLISHED.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_not_established — DUT did not reach ESTABLISHED
• Fail_timeout — no DUT SYN,ACK to simultaneous SYN

verdicts.Fail_not_established: DUT did not reach ESTABLISHED after simultaneous open
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT SYN,ACK to simultaneous SYN
